intro: A stack of cargo crates sits in a commotion by the road.
introDialogue: Could you help for a moment? Some Pokemon are after the cargo. Finish quickly and I can add a bonus.
speaker: Part-Timer
title: Cargo Guard Shift
description:
A part-timer asks you to guard the cargo.
Defeat the attacking Pokemon within 3 turns to earn a bonus.

1.label: Guard the Cargo
1.tooltip:
(!) Double battle against Aipom and Thievul
(+) Earn money on victory
(+) Bonus reward if you win within 3 turns
1.selected: Great, let's start! Keep them away from the cargo!

2.label: Decline
2.selected: That is too bad. I will look for someone else.

turnRemaining3: Three turns remain for the bonus!
turnRemaining2: Two turns remain for the bonus!
turnRemaining1: One turn remains for the bonus!
successBonus: Amazing! You finished in time, so here is the bonus too.
successBase: Thanks. It took a bit, but the cargo is safe.
